title: 第25章 有惊无险第26章 教到他懂
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
离开了武馆以后，叶霄没有回哑巷。
他顺着旧路，拐进了北炉区。
炉火未歇。
赤红的炉口一排排亮着，像是埋在地里的眼。
自从他在北炉待了几天后，工头就没再给他排班。因为他的工时和效率，根本不是其他工人能比的。
在工头眼里，他就是最耐用、最能榨的那个，根本不必再排班。
“这小子真不像快死的样子。”
“我可是赌他活不过月底，看样子钱是打水漂了。”
“他到底是怎么做到，工时那么长，还跟没事人一样？”
工人们看到叶霄出现后，纷纷议论着。
叶霄没有理会旁人，照旧在寒风的冲击下，稳稳地爬上炉沿。
当他踏定位置后，热浪伴随着瘴气，一层一层压上来。
赤血桩起。
这一次，他没有再逼得那么近。
他留了余力。
明天的红单遍布危机。
他必须确保自身状态，到时候稳在最好。
随着站桩开始，叶霄沉稳地走完每一圈桩劲，接着拿起铁铲，配合崩岳拳的力线开始发力。
眨眼后，疼有，热有，但都在能恢复的范围里。

【一证永证】把细小的撕裂，一寸寸补回去。
身体遭受着冷热冲击，脑子却异常清醒。
他记下每一次呼吸的节奏，每一次血液奔流的感觉。
突破之外，也是为了明天不出错。
【赤血桩·大成：80／1200】
【崩岳拳·小成：480／500】
一直到夜深时，叶霄看了一眼命格光字提醒的成长，便从炉沿下来。
衣服湿透，又被炉风烤干，贴在身上硬得发紧。
工头看了他一眼，只说了一句：“今天那么早收工？不打算继续？”
“有其他活。”叶霄回道。
工头没再问，只是注视着叶霄离开的背影。
天还未亮。
红单的任务纸很薄。
薄到折起来，塞进衣襟里贴着心口，冰得发硬。

After leaving the martial arts hall, Ye Xiao did not return to Muxiang.
He followed the old road and turned into Beilu District.
The fire has not stopped.
The red furnace mouths are lit up in rows, like eyes buried in the ground.
Since he had been at Beilu for a few days, the foreman had not assigned him any more shifts. Because his working hours and efficiency are simply not comparable to other workers.
In the eyes of the foreman, he is the most durable and exploitable one, and there is no need to schedule any more shifts.
"This kid really doesn't look like he's about to die."
"I bet he won't survive the end of the month. It looks like the money has been wasted."
"How on earth does he do it, working so long hours, and still acting like nothing is wrong?"
The workers started talking after seeing Ye Xiao appear.
Ye Xiao ignored the others and climbed steadily onto the edge of the stove under the impact of the cold wind.
When he settled on his position, the heat wave accompanied by the miasma came up layer by layer.
Blood piled up.
This time, he didn't press so close.
He left it to chance.
Tomorrow's red orders are full of crises.
He must ensure that his condition is at its best when the time comes.
As the stance began, Ye Xiao walked through each circle of stance calmly, then picked up the shovel and began to exert force in accordance with the force line of Bengyue Fist.
After blinking, I felt pain and heat, but they were within the recovery range.
[One certificate lasts forever] Repair the small tears and repair them inch by inch.
The body was subjected to the shock of cold and heat, but the mind was extremely clear.
He noted the rhythm of every breath, every feeling of blood rushing.
In addition to breakthroughs, it is also about not making mistakes tomorrow.
[Red Blood Stake·Dacheng: 80/1200]
[Bengyue Quan·Xiao Cheng: 480/500]
Until late at night, Ye Xiao took a look at the growth of the fate light word reminder, and then came down from the edge of the furnace.
The clothes were soaked through and dried by the oven wind, making them hard and tight against the body.
The foreman glanced at him and said only: "End work so early today? Don't you plan to continue?"
"I have other jobs." Ye Xiao replied.
The foreman didn't ask any more questions, just watched Ye Xiao's leaving figure.
It's still dark.
The assignment paper for the red list is very thin.
It was so thin that it was folded up, stuffed into the lapel of clothes and pressed against the heart, so cold that it became hard.
